0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-2, 0-1 at home) host the Knicks (0-3, on a three-game losing streak), with Chicago fourth in the Central and 11th in the East and New York 12th in the East. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the series 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
